reasoning: Ismenia is exposed as a monster in Ragusa and must flee to a neighboring region. She has no stationary Resources, so that clause has nothing to act on. She checks a Skill (Talking My Way Past a Locked Gate, fitting for talking her way out of the city and past strangers' gates). Her betrothed Beatriz Gundulić flees with her rather than be abandoned. Among strangers she adopts a new, Slavic name to blend in inland.

operations.description: my betrothed, promised to me since childhood by our fathers' contracts — she fled Ragusa at my side rather than be left behind to answer for me

operations.text: Exposed as a monster in Ragusa, I flee inland with Beatriz Gundulić at my heels; among the strangers of Trebinje I talk my way past the gate-wardens with lies smoother than any contract and take the name Jelena Vranić.
